name: wwdc-mcp
description: Apple developer intelligence for coding agents: WWDC20-WWDC26, HIG, Swift, App Review, API history, and source-grounded app audits.
long_description: WWDC MCP gives coding agents 45 read-only tools for current Apple-platform research: WWDC sessions and transcripts, Apple Developer Documentation, Human Interface Guidelines, Swift Evolution, App Store Review Guidelines, API availability/deprecation, and source-grounded Swift app audits. The bundle launches the pinned v0.2.1 release artifact and preserves stdio MCP transport.
